Graphs through sixteen and max sequences sixteen are identical in both arms; old max-eight results are historical context only.
C16 capacity is tested only for these P256/P2048 and sixty-four-output request groups, not sixteen maximum-length contexts.
All captures stay resident; this is not an incremental graph allocation measurement.
Zero/three ms collection is idle-only; ongoing decode is never delayed. Continuous active arrivals and long outputs remain untested.
C16 uses the unchanged greater-than-eight KDA reconstruction path. This run measures that path without promoting a new kernel.
Actual admitted batch formation can differ; retain both-rank snapshots, input-window events and separate forward trace annotations.
Timing and profiles are separate. Kernel duration sums do not establish device traffic or a cross-rank critical path.
Full-vocabulary comparisons retain KL 1e-5 and absolute NLL 1e-4. Earlier numerical and format failures remain; no release qualification.
No speculative drafter, new quantization, full PPL/GSM8K or roofline collection.
